design_gotchas.title: Operating Temperature Stops at -20°C — NOT Rated for -40°C Industrial Grade
design_gotchas.detail: Unlike LM1117IMPX (-40°C to +125°C) or TLV1117I (-40°C to +125°C), AZ1117CH-3.3TRG1 is specified only from -20°C to +125°C TJ (p.1, p.4, p.7). Do not substitute it into outdoor/industrial -40°C designs without qualification.

design_gotchas.title: H vs. H2 Suffix SOT-223 Pinout Reversal Trap on Page 2
design_gotchas.detail: Page 2 defines two incompatible SOT-223 pinouts in the same datasheet: SOT223/H (AZ1117CH) is standard 1117 (1=ADJ/GND, 2/Tab=OUTPUT, 3=INPUT), whereas SOT223/H2 (AZ1117CH2) swaps pins to 1=INPUT, 2/Tab=ADJ/GND, 3=OUTPUT! Always verify exact 'CH' vs 'CH2' ordering code.

design_gotchas.title: Ceramic-Cap Stable (MLCC Friendly) — Key Advantage Over AMS1117 & LM1117
design_gotchas.detail: Unlike legacy AMS1117 and TI LM1117 which oscillate with MLCCs, AZ1117C is internally compensated for low-ESR ceramic capacitors >= 10 uF with ESR < 20 ohm (p.1, Note 4 p.3), eliminating tantalum BOM cost on standard 1117 footprints.

design_gotchas.title: Higher SOT-223 Thermal Resistance (125°C/W Bare / 100°C/W with 100 mm² Copper)
design_gotchas.detail: Datasheet thermal ratings list θJA = 125°C/W without heatsink and 100°C/W with 100 mm² of 2 oz copper (p.4 Note 6), notably higher than JEDEC 2s2p values cited by TI LM1117. Provide substantial VOUT tab copper and derate current when VIN > 5.5 V.

typical_use_cases: MLCC-only 5 V-to-3.3 V boards replacing tantalum-dependent AMS1117/LM1117 regulators (0 to 20 ohm ESR)
Consumer, office, and indoor embedded 3.3 V rails operating above -20°C up to 800 mA
Candidate drop-in upgrade on standard 1117 SOT-223 footprints to eliminate tantalum capacitors
Cost-optimized 1 A-limit / 800 mA-rated linear post-regulation with 18 V abs-max input margin
engineering_summary: The Diodes Incorporated AZ1117CH-3.3TRG1 is a ceramic-capacitor-stable 800 mA (1.0 A min current limit) SOT-223-3 LDO using the classic 1117 pinout (1=GND, 2/Tab=VOUT, 3=VIN) with 18 V abs-max VIN and 0–20 ohm ESR stability (>= 10 uF MLCC). It is a premier candidate drop-in for AMS1117-3.3 and LM1117 boards seeking to remove tantalum capacitors, provided engineers verify its -20°C minimum junction temperature limit (not -40°C), exact CH vs CH2 suffix, and 100–125°C/W thermal budget before production.

audit_notes: 300 DPI PNG Vision check on p.2 verified SOT223/H pinout (1=ADJ/GND, 2/Tab=OUTPUT, 3=INPUT) and caught the incompatible SOT223/H2 pinout variant.
300 DPI PNG Vision check on p.4 verified VIN abs max=18 V, Rec Op VIN max=15 V, TJ=-20 to +125°C (not -40°C), θJA=125°C/W bare / 100°C/W w/ 100 mm² 2 oz copper, θJC=15°C/W.
Verified ceramic stability (>= 10 uF, ESR < 20 ohm) on p.1 & p.3 Note 4, and AZ1117C-3.3 EC limits on p.7 (1.2 V typ / 1.3 V max dropout @0.8 A, 4 mA IQ, ±2% over temp).
